idea.hook: TOO BUSY TO POST YOUR LISTINGS?

slides.heading: TOO BUSY TO POST YOUR **LISTINGS**?
slides.body: You know they should go out. You just don't have the time.

slides.heading: GOOD LISTINGS THAT NEVER GET **POSTED** WELL
slides.body: A video, a caption, five places, every week. You know the drill. But you're out showing homes, so the listing sits.

slides.heading: THE **EDITING** EATS YOUR NIGHTS
slides.body: Or you edit the video yourself, late at night. It looks basic. And it still only goes up once.

slides.kicker: IT DOESN'T HAVE TO BE THIS WAY
slides.heading: YOUR TIME BELONGS WITH **BUYERS**, NOT EDITING.
slides.body: Let someone else package the listing for you.

slides.heading: I MAKE THE **VIDEO**
slides.body: I turn the listing photos you already have into premium short videos. No filming, no camera crew, no reshoot.

slides.heading: I WRITE THE **CAPTIONS**
slides.body: A clear hook, the basics, three highlights and one action. Every listing, every time.

slides.heading: I **POST** IT EVERYWHERE
slides.body: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and WhatsApp, every week. You focus on the buyers who message.

slides.heading: HAND YOUR LISTINGS **OVER**
slides.body: DM me and ask for a free listing review

caption:
You know your listings should be posted properly. You just don't have the time.

That's the part I take off your plate.
I turn your listing photos into premium short videos, with no filming.
I write the captions and post them across your platforms, every week.
You focus on showing homes and answering buyers.
One extra rental a month covers it.

DM me and ask for a free listing review.
